Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
I see you are advertising Highways and Byways in Spain. I should be much obliged if I might have a copy as my [Sister in law](/person/1604) and her daughters are at Algeciras, where the [husband](/person/386) of [one](/person/388) is Vice Consul. I am expecting the [elder one](/person/1613) to return before the end of the month, and the book would be much enjoyed by us together.
I am glad [Modern Broods](/book/251) is doing well.

It is more than I expected, for I do not think I can attempt any more of the kind after a long spell of success.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
